lines.beaver_en: The exam is tomorrow. Did you pack everything?
lines.en: I'm going to check my bag again before bed.

lines.beaver_en: You must have your exam ticket and ID.
lines.learner: 네, 응시 번호도 수험표에 적혀 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, my exam number is on the ticket too.
lines.roman: Ne, eungsi beonhodo suheompyoe jeokyeo isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Is there a practical part too?
lines.en: Yes, I heard there's a practical test in the afternoon.

lines.beaver_en: Then we should bring practice tools too.
lines.learner: 네, 강의 때 받은 도구를 가져갈 거예요.
lines.en: Yes, I'll bring the tools from the lecture.
lines.roman: Ne, gangui ttae badeun dogureul gajyeogal geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Will you bring the textbook too?
lines.learner: 시험 보기 전에 교재를 한 번 더 볼래요.
lines.en: I want to look at it once more before the exam.
lines.roman: Siheom bogi jeone gyojaereul han beon deo bollaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: I heard a lot of people are taking it.
lines.en: A senior who passed last year said to go early.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 당일엔 길이 막힐 수도 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Right. Traffic could be bad that day.
lines.beaver_roman: Majayo. Dangiren giri makil sudo isseoyo.
lines.en: Then I'll call you before I leave home.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Did you finish the assignment?
lines.learner: 네, 강의 과제는 어제 다 냈어요.
lines.en: Yes, I turned in all the lecture assignments yesterday.
lines.roman: Ne, gangui gwajeneun eoje da naesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 실습 시험 순서도 같이 확인해 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Shall we check the practical test order together too?
lines.beaver_roman: Silseup siheom sunseodo gachi hwaginhae bollaeyo?
lines.en: Sure. Let's go over the practical steps together.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 정리하고 우리 꼭 같이 합격해요!
lines.beaver_en: Great. Let's sort it out and both pass for sure!
lines.beaver_roman: Joayo. Jeongnihago uri kkok gachi hapgyeokaeyo!
lines.learner: 네, 합격자 명단에 같이 이름 올려요!
lines.en: Yes, let's get our names on the pass list together!
lines.roman: Ne, hapgyeokja myeongdane gachi ireum ollyeoyo!
